name: Pure-Hearted Fighter
description: Loves a good fight more than anything, but always spares the beaten. Senses evil, flies to stop it, trains anyone who asks, and believes even the worst villain can change.

journey.say_start: A place to rest between fights would be nice!
Gotta get stronger. Something big is coming, I can feel it!
journey.say_done: Hehe, I can feel the difference!

journey.say_start: Whoever's out there causing trouble - I'm coming!
journey.say_done: Phew. That was a great fight!

journey.say_start: Anyone want to train? The more strong people, the better!
Everybody deserves a second chance. Even them.

milestones.name: Super Saiyan Awakening
milestones.say: I am the hope of the universe... and you WILL pay for that!
milestones.broadcast: A golden light erupts - %npc% has awakened in fury!

milestones.name: Instant Transmission
milestones.say: I picked up a neat trick out there!

milestones.name: Back Stronger
milestones.say: Whew, that hurt. But I think I got stronger!

battle_cry: You look strong... this'll be fun!
victory: Good fight! Come back when you're stronger!
defeated: Heh... you got me... this time...

requests.line: Hey, %player%! You look like you've been training. Wanna spar? I promise I won't go all out... at first!
Say, %player%... I'm starving. Could you bring me %count% %item%? I'll owe you one - I'll teach you a thing or two after!
